HOW IT WORKS

A clear process. Teachers stay in control.

SASA supports preparation and organisation; teachers remain responsible for checking content, answers and marks.

01

Connect the curriculum

Register the relevant curriculum source, import its class and subject entries, then verify them against the source document.

02

Generate draft questions

Choose a class, subject, verified topic and learning outcome. Set the question count, format and cognitive level.

03

Review and approve

Check the question, expected answer and marking guide. Approve suitable items into the reusable question bank.

04

Build an activity or paper

Select the questions you want, create an activity or examination, then download the student paper or teacher copy.

BUILT AROUND SCHOOL WORKFLOWS

Support for teachers and school teams

Prepare class activities, topic assessments and examination papers with reusable, reviewed questions. Curriculum managers can organise source documents and imported curriculum entries.
